text:
Type: black gooseneck clip-on LED lamp
Use: focused light clamped to a desk, shelf or headboard; home office, study, bedroom
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: glossy black metal LED head, flexible black gooseneck, black plastic spring clamp, black cord
Colors: glossy black
Shape: tiny teardrop head on a thin curved gooseneck, sprung clip with gripping jaws, small and very light, easy to aim
Feel: practical, discreet, sleek, compact
Goes with: white or wood desks, bookshelves, black accents; minimalist or contemporary home offices and bedrooms

product.name: JANSJ
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm is adjustable.
